title: Glottolog is a catalogue of languages, not a headcount to memorize
body: Glottolog, at the about page consulted on 18 November 2026, presents itself as version 5.4. The page describes a collaborative project. It credits Harald Hammarström with collecting many individuals' bibliographies and compiling them into a master bibliography, and the site organizes languages and families. A catalogue of this kind has to decide what counts as a language rather than a dialect, and those decisions are argued. This card states no number of languages. Any count would be Glottolog's count under its criteria at a stated version, and a different catalogue uses different criteria. The useful fact is the existence of a versioned, citable classification and bibliography, not a round number of "world languages."
